$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: Price
whenToUse: Any amount of money in the UI: plan cards, checkout, invoices, add-ons.
A discount (`compareAt`), a “from” price, a billing period.

whenNotToUse.text: A column of amounts in a table

anatomy.description: Intl-formatted for `currency` and `locale`; whole amounts drop .00; zero shows “Free”.

do.caption: Formatted for the locale, with period and the old price.
do.example: <Price amount={19.99} compareAt={24.99} currency="EUR" locale="de-DE" period="mo" size="lg" />

dont.caption: Hand-typed: wrong for German readers, and read aloud as fragments.

a11y: Screen readers hear one sentence: “From €19.99 per month, was €24.99”; the visual pieces are hidden.
The old price is never the only discount signal — the badge and the sentence say it too.
Pass the real `locale`; the symbol position and separators follow it.

props.name: compareAt
props.description: Previous price, shown struck through before the current one.

props.name: freeLabel
props.description: Text for a zero amount. Pass null to show "$0" instead.

props.name: period
props.description: Short billing period shown after the amount: "mo", "year", "user"… Read out as "per month" etc.

props.name: showDiscount
props.description: Show "−20%" next to a discounted price.

props.name: superscript
props.description: lg/xl only: raise the currency symbol and cents (retail price-tag style) instead of keeping them on the baseline.
